antimage_mana_break.desc: Each attack burns a flat amount plus a share of the target's maximum mana and deals part of the burned mana as extra physical damage.

antimage_blink.desc: Teleports Anti-Mage toward the target point; clicking past the maximum range blinks the full distance. Cannot be used while rooted.

antimage_counterspell.desc: Passively grants magic resistance. Activate for a brief anti-magic shell that blocks enemy spells aimed at Anti-Mage and casts them back at their owner. Instant.

antimage_persectur.desc: Anti-Mage's attacks slow enemies that are low on mana; the emptier their mana pool, the harder the slow.

antimage_mana_void.desc: Punishes an enemy for the mana it lacks: every missing point of its mana becomes magical damage to it and to enemies around it. The target is briefly stunned.
